name: Cruising in the Stellar Sea
desc:
Coursing 'tween the sea of stars,
THEY cruise with the speed of a rainbow's chromatic flash.
A journey of hunting undying abominations,
collecting cures and miracles,
and seeking deliverance.
Akin to a vow unbroken, THEIR voyage will be,
ad infinitum.

ability.name: Chase
ability.desc: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {0}%, and increases their CRIT Rate against enemies with HP percentage 50% or less by an extra {1}%. When the wearer defeats an enemy, their ATK is increased by {2}% for 2 turn(s).
